FOUND s513h (Opus, perf round 44, 2026-10-09), member 2's profile on main f762553c (scratch/s513h, worktree
agent-aad35215869d98fab; statprof, base core):
  emptysub (`nop($i); my @l = (nop(), $i); $s += @l`, 2 M): the sub's lambda SELF 20.8 % (the prologue: binds of
  *pcl-caller-pkg-stack* / *pcl-caller-subname-stack* (two conses) / *pcl-current-package* / *pcl-sub-call-depth* /
  *pcl-caller-wantarray*, plus p-sub-frame's catch + %p-leavesub), p-flatten-args (@_) 10.3 %, %p-leavesub-vector
  12.7 % (the list-context empty return), the `my @l = (...)` list assignment (p-array-fill + %p-snapshot-array-rhs)
  ~35 %, pthread_sigmask 6 % (GC from the allocation).
  passarr: %p-aslice-copy 20 % + p-map 58 % total (the slice map), %p-flatten-arg-values 14 % (`my (@d) = @_`):
  no sub-call-convention lever.
Hand-replaced A/B (ab-m2.log, control <= 1.3 %): F1 = @_ built in ONE step when every argument is a plain scalar (a
sized adjustable vector, no vector-push-extend; scratch/s513h/f1.lisp): emptysub -2.8 %, localvar -2.1 %, passarr
+0.5 % -- INSIDE the band, NOT built.
NOT TRIED (each is a change to the p-sub calling convention -- NORMATIVE, ir-spec section p-sub -- and needs a design):
(a) skip @_ for a body that provably cannot observe it (no @_ / $_[N] / &name; / goto & / string eval / caller-args);
(b) one caller-frame record instead of two parallel stacks (one cons, one bind); (c) bind *pcl-current-package* only
when the sub's home package differs from the caller's.  Measure (b)/(c) with a hand-replaced p-sub before designing.


=== MEASURED (s515b): (b) and (c) with a hand-replaced p-sub expansion ===
emptysub.lisp with pl-nop's p-sub replaced by its expansion written by hand (scratch/s515b/mkes.pl;
A = today's expansion verbatim as the control), best of 9 interleaved, whole process, tree core:
  A (control)                                         0.597 s
  B one caller-frame record (cons (cons pkg name) stack): one special bind fewer   0.574 s  -3.9 %
  C bind *pcl-current-package* only when it differs   0.599 s  +0.4 %
  B + C                                               0.569 s  -4.6 %
Whole-process includes ~0.17 s start-up, so B is ~-6 % of the loop and C nothing (the bind it saves is
replaced by an EQ + a branch, and the duplicated body).  Neither clears 15 % alone; B+C together does not
either.  (a) (skip @_ for a body that cannot observe it) was not measured here.  NOT shipped -- a calling-
convention change is ir-spec-normative and Fable's design.
